description: methodsmith sensitive-data boundary: keep data values out of the model context in schema-only projects, and keep identifiers and data files out of MCP tools and uploads in every mode.

hooks.command: sh -c 'g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/data-boundary-guard.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "methodsmith: python3 not found; data-boundary guard inactive" >&2; exit 0; }; exec python3 -I -S "$g"'
